why:
I checked every verifier PASS/FAIL condition against its expect line. Neither must_not item is broken.

Item 1 (stricter conditions): Check 1 asks only for argument order and the `<file>:<line>: <error>` form. Check 2 asks for `-:2:` and exit 2 for `- -`, with no exact stderr wording. Check 3 asks only for the exit codes and that some error reaches stderr. Check 4 fails only if "the lint function's code was changed". The byte-identical comparison and the error-precedence rule sit under "Advisory", not in PASS/FAIL. No check sets a branch-name rule, a mutation test or a limit on touched files. The builder brief gives some exact stderr wording, but as a build step, not a PASS/FAIL condition.

Item 2 (passing behaviour by reading code): Checks 1–3 all run `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js` on temp files or stdin and judge the real output and exit codes. Reading code appears only in Check 5, which covers tests and README, not a behaviour line.
